subject: zoology_2
question_text: Describe the process of digestion of proteins in the stomach.

mark_split.label: HCl and the activation of pepsin

insider_note: Four reactions carry this answer: pepsinogen to pepsin, protein to proteoses and peptones, prorennin to rennin, and casein to calcium paracaseinate. Write each one, and keep the sentence that explains it.

steps.label: Gastric juice and chyme
steps.why: Protein digestion is the one digestion that truly begins in the stomach, so the answer has to say where it starts and where it ends.
common_mistakes: Writing that protein digestion is completed in the stomach. It ends in the small intestine.
Calling the stomach contents chyle. The stomach forms chyme.
steps.memory_tip: Chyme is made in the stomach; chyle is the fatty lymph fluid.
steps.margin_note: Two or three lines. Name the juice and name chyme.

steps.label: HCl activates pepsin
steps.why: Pepsin is secreted in an inactive form so that it cannot digest the gland that makes it; the acid is what switches it on.
common_mistakes: Writing that the stomach secretes pepsin. It secretes pepsinogen.
Giving an alkaline pH. The stomach works at about pH 1.8.
steps.memory_tip: Pepsinogen is the sleeping form; HCl wakes it into pepsin.
steps.margin_note: Name the four contents of gastric juice, then the activation.

steps.label: Pepsin acts on proteins
steps.why: Pepsin breaks long protein chains only part of the way, which is why the products are still large fragments and not amino acids.
common_mistakes: Writing that pepsin gives amino acids. It gives proteoses and peptones.
Leaving out autocatalysis. Pepsin also activates more pepsinogen.
steps.memory_tip: Pepsin stops halfway: proteins become proteoses and peptones.
steps.margin_note: One equation line is enough here.

steps.label: Rennin in infants
steps.why: An infant lives on milk, so the stomach needs an enzyme that curdles milk protein before pepsin can work on it.
common_mistakes: Confusing rennin with renin. Renin is a kidney enzyme that raises blood pressure.
Writing that rennin acts in adults. It is active in infants.
steps.memory_tip: Rennin curdles milk in infants; renin comes from the kidney.
steps.margin_note: Finish with the time taken. It is an easy extra mark.
